data.content_ref: inline:The problem statement requires a regression suite for TWO untested refusals: (1) a frozen route lease whose endpoint drifted, and (2) a school-to-seat binding whose endpoint identity disagrees with the frozen seat. SRC_001 addresses only the first refusal (lease-mismatch before provider call) and entirely omits the second refusal (school-to-seat binding coverage). The target's scope, mechanism, and forbidden case all concern exclusively the lease-mismatch path; there is no test skeleton, forbidden case, or fixture addressing the school-to-seat binding disagreement. This is not merely scope the problem never asked for — it is a missing required deliverable half of the suite.
